Week 1 · A1 · Beginner

Le présent

A French verb changes its ending for each person: je parle, nous parlons, vous parlez.

Pick a person and a verb. Watch the magenta verb block change its ending.

Stem + ending. The ending matches the person.

Most French verbs end in -er in the dictionary, such as parler (to speak). Take off -er and you have the stem, parl-. Then add the ending for the person. The good news: -e, -es, -e and -ent all sound the same, so in speech only nous (-ons) and vous (-ez) sound different. The two most important verbs, être (to be) and avoir (to have), are irregular: learn them by heart first.

Pattern

PersonEndingparlerêtreavoir
je (I)-eparlesuisai (j’ai)
tu (you, informal)-esparlesesas
il / elle / on (he / she / we, informal)-eparleesta
nous (we)-onsparlonssommesavons
vous (you, several or formal)-ezparlezêtesavez
ils / elles (they)-ent (silent)parlentsontont

je shrinks to j’ before a vowel or a silent h: j’habite, j’ai. vous is also the polite “you” for one stranger, in shops and offices: Vous parlez anglais ? on means “we” in everyday speech and uses the il form: On parle français.

Examples

No French voice was found on this device, so the ▶ écouter buttons are hidden.

  • Je m’appelle Kofi et je viens du Ghana. My name is Kofi and I come from Ghana.
  • Tu habites où ? Where do you live?
  • Elle est professeure et elle travaille à Lyon. She is a teacher and works in Lyon.
  • Nous avons faim. We’re hungry.
  • Vous parlez anglais ? Do you speak English?

Common mistakes

  • Je parler français. → Je parle français. The -er form is only for the dictionary.
  • Je ai faim. → J’ai faim. je becomes j’ before a vowel.
  • Je suis 25 ans. → J’ai 25 ans. Age uses avoir: you “have” years.
  • French has one present tense: je parle means both “I speak” and “I am speaking”.

Quiz

Parler: introduce yourself

A1 goal: introduce yourself and talk about your day in short, simple sentences. Say four sentences about yourself, out loud:

  • Je m’appelle … / Je suis …
  • Je viens de … et j’habite à …
  • Je parle … et j’apprends le français.
  • J’ai … (deux frères / un chat / 30 ans).
